annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it invites viewers to invest in a bitcoin-mining business, buy accounts, and join a binary team structure tied to bonuses and cycle payments. It promotes substantial earnings, including a $3,500 profit example and monthly team bitcoin earnings valued at $2 million, while the described records do not verify mining operations or payout results.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The presentation devotes substantial attention to building left and right teams, placing new members beneath accounts, and earning cycle payments from those teams. That recruitment-linked income structure is the central mechanism explained in detail. The same offer also sells mining-pool participation and claims continuing returns from purchased shares.
